# Weekly Log 2026-09

## Week 36

Collected the first two cryostat quotes and opened the [[Cryostat Vendor Shortlist]]. Drafted the milestone list in [[Test Stand Plan]]. Asked facilities whether the lab power feed can take a large compressor; no answer yet. Reviewed one deck and found two accent colours on one slide, which is now the first entry under common mistakes in [[Deck Style Notes]].

## Week 37

Vendor Gamma sent a brochure and nothing else. The stepper stage arrived and was measured; it needs a clear bore of at least 190 millimetres. Added the bore question to the shortlist. Facilities said the feed is 10 kilowatts today and an upgrade takes eight weeks, which rules out the pulse tube option unless the upgrade starts now.

## Week 38

Warm fit check moved to the second week of October because the probe mount is late. Wrote the pass condition for milestone one. Reviewed the reviewer deck against the style notes; one number on slide four did not match the plan and was corrected. Glossary entries for beta and separatrix were rewritten in plain words, see [[Glossary]].

## Week 39

Rescored the shortlist with the bore and power facts. Vendor Alpha leads if the bore is clear. Call planned for Monday. No deck reviews this week. The harness test uses this log as a sample note, so every fact in it is invented.
